name: Harmless Offering, Donate, Bazaar Trader — who can be given control, and of what
notes: Found by tests/audit.py once give-control units were audited (2026-11-17). "Target opponent gains control of …" showed the any-player picker, you included; the player list (getPlayerCandidates, cards-targeting.js) now leaves you out when the text says "target opponent" or "Choose another player" (_chosenPlayerNotYou). Bazaar Trader's "target artifact, creature, or land you control" was split into two "or" choices, the first listing the opponent's creatures and no lands; a type list inside a target is no choice (cards-battlefield.js). Donate, cast after Harmless Offering, offered that spell as a permanent to give away: a spell on the stack is no permanent (CR 110.1), and _isPermanent (engine-helpers.js) now says so.
